title: Catalina Island Coastline View, 1957 California B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A deckled-edge black and white snapshot showing a scenic view of the Santa Catalina Island coastline taken from the water in May 1957. Buildings and the Chimes Tower are visible along the rolling hillside above the bay. Handwritten in ink across the sky on the front is 'Catlina Island, California', with the photo developer's date stamp 'MAY • 57' along the right white margin. The print has an old horizontal fold/crease across the center.
